_comment: Weapon definitions for Omega Realm. Holds each weapon's display, drop gating (tier_requirement required, biome_requirement optional), class restrictions, base stats, affixes, and any granted ability. The Rust omega-server is the numeric authority for all weapon stats and combat effects (it owns the sim and decides damage; 'the client requests, the server decides'), with durable item ownership persisted by the Go API (Postgres); this file mirrors definitions for client display/tooling and the server wins on disagreement. Governing GDD docs: docs/gdd/loot.md (item-definition fields; STATUS: TBD/UNBUILT — no item/weapon system in code today), docs/gdd/BIOMES.md (tier->biome mapping), data/schemas/item_schema.json. Class bytes: 0 Zealot,1 VoidHunter,2 Engineer,3 PlagueSeer,4 Warrior,5 Rogue,6 Mage (only Warrior/Rogue/Mage in pre-alpha scope). TODO: every weapon is unfilled pending design; the single example below is schema-shape only.

weapons._comment: Keyed by stable item id. One schema-shaped example entry. tier_requirement = min monster tier that can drop it (required); biome_requirement = optional single-biome restriction (null/omit = any qualifying biome); class_restriction = list of allowed class bytes (empty = all).
